mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not higher when GDP grows.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment signals a strong labor market, boosting S&P 500 in 5 days.
failure_condition: Returns don't increase when unemployment drops below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth outpacing employment suggests supply strength, aiding S&P 500 in 60 days.
failure_condition: No positive returns when INDPRO exceeds PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: Lower Fed Funds in easing cycles boost equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns don't rise when Fed Funds drop below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate strong demand, boosting S&P 500 in 60 days.
failure_condition: No positive returns with increasing housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: CPI above 3% may lead to tightening, negatively impacting S&P 500 in 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns don't drop when CPI exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: Both retail sales and industrial production growth signal strong demand, boosting S&P 500 in 20 days.
failure_condition: No positive returns when both proxies grow.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment in late-cycle expansion may lead to wage inflation, affecting S&P 500 in 5 days.
failure_condition: Returns don't decrease when unemployment is low in late-cycle.
